tagline: A simple booking page for Amber's lawn care business
painPoint: You said it yourself — chasing one client for almost a week for payment, wondering if it's worth the reliability hit to keep her. This flips the order: clients pay when they book the cut, so there's nothing left to chase afterward.
demoSubtitle: Built for Amber — clients pay when they book, so a slow payer never turns into a week of chasing calls and texts.
features: Payment collected upfront at booking, before the mow ever happens
No more calls and texts just to get paid for work already done
One-time cost, no monthly subscription stacked on top
You still run the job the same way, just don't have to chase money anymore
